sections.h2: One contractor for every painted surface on the property
body: Williston properties rarely need just one thing. A house in Pine Run might need its siding repainted, its deck restained, and its driveway washed. A building downtown might need a storefront refreshed and an office interior done after hours. Our painting services in Williston, FL are built so one walkthrough covers all of it, and one crew lead stays responsible from start to finish.

Everything is done by our own crews. We do not hand off the deck to one sub and the cabinets to another, which keeps the prep standards and the schedule consistent across the whole job. Our Williston location page explains how we approach the town as a whole.

sections.h2: Matching the service to the building
body: The right scope depends on what is standing on the lot. These are the combinations we price most often in the Williston area:
bullets: Established homes: exterior repaints paired with a pre-paint wash and trim repair
Farm and acreage parcels: house, outbuildings, and board fencing listed as separate line items
New US-27 build-outs: interior upgrades from flat builder paint to washable finishes
Downtown storefronts and offices: exterior trim and doors plus interiors scheduled outside business hours
Kitchens: cabinet refinishing timed alongside a wall repaint

sections.h2: Specialty work that rides along with a repaint
body: Beyond walls and siding, our specialty services include drywall repair, popcorn ceiling removal, wallpaper removal, stucco repair, concrete and masonry coatings, garage floor epoxy and polyaspartic systems, waterproofing, and decorative finishes like limewash and venetian plaster. Folding those into the same visit saves a second round of setup and masking.
For the core house work itself, our main services page explains each discipline in more depth.

sections.h2: Products, coats, and what stays consistent
body: Whatever the mix, the product rules are the same. Siding and trim get 100% acrylic, stucco with hairline movement gets elastomeric, cabinets and doors get waterborne urethane enamel, and exposed wood gets a penetrating stain. We use premium Sherwin-Williams and Benjamin Moore lines and name the exact product on the estimate. Two full coats is the baseline. Low-VOC options are available for interiors and occupied buildings.

When a project combines exterior and interior work, we usually plan the exterior for the October through May window and slot interior rooms wherever the weather is less cooperative. Washing comes first, then repairs, then coatings, then wood staining once surfaces have dried. Most projects start one to three weeks after approval, and the order of work is written into the estimate.
